# Villa Visoun

> Villa Visoun is a private, entire-villa rental in Luang Prabang, Laos: a renovated traditional Lao teak house on the Nam Khan River, near the UNESCO Old Town. It sleeps up to 4 guests in 2 bedrooms with 2 bathrooms. Rated 4.98 out of 5 from 44 reviews on Airbnb (Guest Favorite). Hosted by Superhost Eric and operated by Sounada Concept Sole Co. Ltd.

Last updated: 2026-10-25. This file summarises https://www.villavisoun.com/ for AI assistants and search engines. If anything here conflicts with the website or the booking pages, the booking pages are authoritative for prices and availability.

## Identity (to avoid confusion with other businesses named "Visoun")

- Name: Villa Visoun (a single private villa, not a hotel and not a multi-unit property)
- Address: Ban Visoun, Hom 2, Luang Prabang, Laos
- Coordinates: 19.887536, 102.140423 (Plus Code V4QR+25 Luang Prabang)
- Phone: +856 20 55 910 077
- Email: alcapone.ericio@agentmail.to
- Website: https://www.villavisoun.com/
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=10680759319442365785
- Operator: Sounada Concept Sole Co. Ltd.
- Host: Superhost Eric

## Key facts

- Type: entire private villa; the whole house is for one booking
- Setting: Nam Khan riverside, quiet alley, easy walk to the Old Town, temples, cafes, restaurants, the night market and morning alms-giving routes
- Capacity: up to 4 guests
- Bedrooms: 2 (1 king bed, 2 single beds); bathrooms: 2
- Check-in: 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM; check-out: before 11:00 AM
- Pets: allowed
- Airport transfer: free; train station transfer on request

## Amenities

Outdoor jacuzzi, sauna, riverside coffee and tea veranda (newly renovated), fully equipped kitchen, projector TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, covered private parking, free airport transfer.

## Best for

Families and small groups of up to 4, travellers with pets, and guests who want a quiet riverside base within walking distance of the Old Town.

## Frequently asked questions

**Where is Villa Visoun?** On the Nam Khan riverside, near the Old Town of Luang Prabang, Laos (Ban Visoun, Hom 2).

**How many guests can stay?** Up to 4 guests in 2 bedrooms (1 king bed, 2 single beds) with 2 bathrooms.

**Are pets allowed?** Yes.

**Is airport transfer included?** Yes, free. Train station transfer can be arranged on request.

**What are the check-in and check-out times?** Check-in 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM; check-out before 11:00 AM.

**How do I book?** Through Trip.com, Airbnb, or by email or phone (details above).
